TOOLING BURST T4s-r3 — E3 fields, the design lap after the first rendered look (Run C-5; conductor R-C5-63: F-C5-16 the fire pool reads as a pale cream pancake; F-C5-17 the poison cloud reads as an opaque cartoon green bush and the lobe splash is not seen). task_id "T4s-r3".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a (palette/material), T4s, T4r (decal precedent).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (G2 component: field body, licks, cloud, lobes, decal), export/effect_kit.py (G2 kit fields, palettes), export/vfx_material.gdshader, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/blackwater_cocktail_e3/kit.json + poisonous_concoction_e3/kit.json, the NEW painting runs/C-5/artifacts/VF-prim-fire-pool-01/fire_pool_01_512.png (four-plane greyscale RGBA, the P03 fire field body, painted foreshortened: pool ≈ 300×130 px + flames ~80 px above), the conductor's rendered evidence runs/C-5/t3/E1-judge-v29/BWC_dirt_E_contact.png + PC_dirt_E_contact.png (frames labelled in real frame numbers), tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_godot_import.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only.

BUILD (legacy kits byte-identical): (1) BLACKWATER FIELD — replace the placeholder field body (the squashed core piece) with the painted P03 fire pool: placed at the landing point at 1.0 scale (it is painted foreshortened — NO further ground squash), on GroundEffects; the three licks now ride ON the pool's flame tongues (spawn positions sampled from the pool's plane-3 pixels) and pulse on the tick schedule; the pool's own planes 0–1 must stay DARK in the fire palette (band 0 dark ember, band 1 deep red) — verify the palette bands map so that a mostly-band-1 body renders deep red, not cream; the pool fades by dissolve (3, 2, then 1+0) over the last 0.4 s of duration_s; scorch decal after. (2) CONCOCTION CLOUD — the density puff must read as a translucent, banded gas: kit `density` 0.75 (alpha), the poison palette a true four-band ramp (band 0 dark olive-black (0.10,0.14,0.06), band 1 deep green (0.20,0.42,0.16), band 2 sickly yellow-green (0.55,0.78,0.30), band 3 pale acid (0.85,0.95,0.60)) so the lobes' planes show; the cloud breathes (alpha 0.65–0.8) on the tick schedule; the four LOBES at the splash must be visible: 0.25 s life, translating low and short from the landing point, band planes intact, on GroundEffects above the cloud; the puddle decal darker than the cloud. (3) both flasks: verify the flask sprite is visible in flight in a headless trace at three ages with its global z/alpha/scale logged (F-C5-13 residual: the Blackwater flask was still not seen in flight in v29 while the Concoction flask was — compare the two kits' flask emission and make them identical in layer and scale).
Tests (unittest, stdlib): kit validation with the pool binding + palettes + density; emitted node tree; a headless trace with the per-node table (z, alpha, visible, position) at three ages for both kits including both flasks in flight; legacy hash table; headless import exit 0.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4s-r3/acceptance.json): the trace tables; legacy byte identity; in-sandbox suite reds named. Rendered = conductor's next capture.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/ (run only), export/replay.py, any test file except the two named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4s-r3/ and the two G2 kit directories. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4s-r3/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4s-r3"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
